outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic/illustrative example demonstrating image cropping, rotation and resizing practices, not a presentation of replicated experimental data requiring an n-number.
Panel b illustrates image spacing/formatting best practice with example images; it is not reporting replicated experimental data.
Panel c is an illustrative example showing how to present magnified insets; it does not present replicated quantitative or experimental data.
Panel d shows example images illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment as a methods guideline, not replicated experimental data.
Panel e demonstrates channel annotation practices with illustrative example images, not a presentation requiring replicate reporting.
Panel f illustrates the guideline of using grayscale channels with example images, not replicated experimental data.
Panel g illustrates use of calibration/intensity scales with example images as a methods best-practice demonstration, not a report of replicated experimental data.
